description: This file is a Perl module named LightyTest that provides a test harness for testing the lighttpd server. It includes methods for starting/stopping the server, handling HTTP requests, checking features, and managing sockets for testing purposes.

classes.name: LightyTest
classes.description: A Perl object class providing methods for starting, stopping, and interacting with a lighttpd server instance for testing purposes.

methods.name: mtime
methods.description: Returns the modification time of a file, or 0 if the file does not exist.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new LightyTest instance, initializes configuration paths and environment detection.

methods.name: listening_on
methods.description: Checks if the server is listening on a specified port.

methods.name: stop_proc
methods.description: Stops the server process if it is running, handling different platform-specific process termination.

methods.name: wait_for_port_with_proc
methods.description: Waits until the server is listening on a specified port or times out.

methods.name: bind_ephemeral_tcp_socket
methods.description: Creates and binds a TCP socket to an ephemeral port, returning the socket and port.

methods.name: get_ephemeral_tcp_port
methods.description: Binds to an ephemeral port and returns its port number.

methods.name: cygpath_alm
methods.description: Converts a Unix path to a Windows or Cygwin style path.

methods.name: start_proc
methods.description: Starts the lighttpd server process with appropriate environment variables and configuration.

methods.name: handle_http
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request and processes the response during testing.

methods.name: spawnfcgi
methods.description: Spawns a FastCGI application process on a specified port.

methods.name: has_feature
methods.description: Checks if the lighttpd binary has a specific feature enabled by parsing its version output.

methods.name: has_crypto
methods.description: Checks if the lighttpd binary has crypto support enabled by parsing its version output.
